$comment: Registry of Machine-registered products. This file is the source of truth
for WHICH projects this storefront is allowed to represent. It is written by
`resale` is the field that stops a real project being published as a
sellable product without a decision. The gate refuses to publish anything
whose resale is not 'allowed'. BLG-GEL-001 was cleared for resale by its
owner and published in WEBSTR001-C023; the entry and the catalog row record
the price, contact path and free-edition download.
`status` is the storefront's own lifecycle, not the template project's:
draft      - registered, deliberately not published, needs pricing + owner sign-off
published  - live in the storefront catalog and in sitemap.xml
withdrawn  - was published, must not be any more
